preview.what: Five habits that keep code changeable, shown with Laravel code you'd actually write.
preview.picture: A kitchen where each station does one job, new dishes don't require rewiring the stove, and any chef can swap in because the tools follow the same contract.
preview.why: 'Give me an example of SOLID from your own code' is a top-5 senior question.
preview.bn: পাঁচটা অভ্যাস যাতে code বদলানো সহজ থাকে — Laravel-এর নিজের code দিয়ে।
